definitions.gloss: to hold back, to check, to stop
definitions.explanation: To prevent something from advancing, spreading, or getting worse by firmly stopping it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|く}い{止|と}める。
examples.english: To hold back the enemy's attack.

examples.japanese: ⟦{感染|かんせん}→感染：05977_kansen⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|く}い{止|と}める⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Measures to stop the spread of infection are needed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{最小限|さいしょうげん}→最小限：13072_saishougen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{食|く}い{止|と}めた。
examples.english: The damage was kept to a minimum.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤字|あかじ}→赤字：04712_akaji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{何|なん}とか→何とか：01126_nantoka⟧{食|く}い{止|と}めたい。
examples.english: I want to somehow stop the deficit from growing.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB: ⟦{食|く}う→食う：02657_kuu⟧ (to bite/eat into) + ⟦{止|と}める→止める：00678_tomeru⟧ (to stop) = to bite into and stop (i.e., to firmly hold in place)

TRANSITIVITY: Transitive. Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ to mark what is being stopped or checked.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{攻撃|こうげき}→攻撃：02748_kougeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|く}い{止|と}める (to check an attack)
- ⟦{感染|かんせん}→感染：05977_kansen⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|く}い{止|と}める (to stop the spread of infection)
- ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|く}い{止|と}める (to prevent damage)
- ⟦{浸水|しんすい}→浸水：14945_shinsui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|く}い{止|と}める (to stop flooding)
- ⟦{赤字|あかじ}→赤字：04712_akaji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|く}い{止|と}める (to check losses)

USAGE NOTE: Often used in news contexts for disasters, epidemics, military situations, and economic crises. Implies urgent action to prevent something from getting worse.

RELATED ～{止|と}める COMPOUND VERBS:
- ⟦{引|ひ}き{止|と}める→引き止める：06166_hikitomeru⟧ - to hold back (a person)
- ⟦{押|お}し{止|と}める→押し止める：29660_oshitomeru⟧ - to hold down, to suppress
- ⟦{呼|よ}び{止|と}める→呼び止める：29661_yobitomeru⟧ - to call out and stop someone
